layout.arrangement: A single white slide framed by a thin red rectangular border (approx. x 6%-94%, y 8%-93%). The large red title 'Precision' sits at the top, centered over the left two-thirds of the slide. The left column (approx. x 7%-68%) is a vertical stack: a gray definition box (two bold black lines separated by a red horizontal rule), a pale-yellow 'Meaning' box, a red rounded-rectangle formula box with a light-blue worked-example box to its right, two small callout tags ('Positive Classified as +ve' / 'Negative Classified as +ve') with a green curly brace and a red italic caption beneath, and finally a light-blue italic takeaway box at the bottom-left. The right column (approx. x 70%-92%) holds two stacked blue-framed confusion matrices (symbolic on top, numeric below) and, below them, a large red-framed tree diagram box spanning x 55%-92%, y 53%-92%. A yellow rounded badge with '9' is tucked into the extreme top-right corner, partly overlapped by the upper matrix frame. A black horizontal video-player bar runs along the very bottom edge of the image, outside the slide border.

layout.hierarchy: The oversized bold red title 'Precision' dominates the top. Next in weight are the large red 'Meaning' heading and the red-outlined formula box, which act as the visual anchor of the left column. The gray definition band and the yellow meaning band are wide horizontal blocks of bold black text. The right side is visually dense but smaller-scale: two blue-framed confusion matrices and the red-framed tree diagram, whose saturated red and green filled circles (30, 5, 25, 70, 70, 0) are the strongest color accents on the slide. The bottom-left blue takeaway box is secondary, set in italic blue/red text.

visual_elements.description: White rounded rectangle with a thick red outline containing the precision formula: 'Precision =' on the left, then a horizontal fraction bar with 'TP' as numerator and 'TP + FP' as denominator, all in bold black.
Light-blue rectangle with a thin blue border containing two centered bold blue lines: 'Precision= 5/(5+0)' and '= 100%'.

Two small tag/callout shapes with pointer tails aimed upward at the formula: left tag is pale yellow with black text 'Positive' / 'Classified as +ve' and a yellow triangular pointer reaching up toward the 'TP' numerator; right tag is pale orange with black text 'Negative' / 'Classified as +ve' and an orange triangular pointer reaching up toward the 'FP' denominator.
Green curly brace (horizontal, opening upward) spanning beneath both callout tags, grouping them together; below it a red italic caption 'All Samples classified as Positive'.

Symbolic 2x2 confusion matrix inside a blue rectangular frame. Red bold header 'Predicted as' centered above the two columns; column headers 'P' and 'N' in black; vertical red bold 'Actual' label rotated 90 degrees along the left edge; row headers 'P' and 'N' in black. Cells separated by thin red grid lines: top-left 'TP' on a light-green fill, top-right 'FN' on white, bottom-left 'FP' on white, bottom-right 'TN' on a light-green fill.

Numeric 2x2 confusion matrix inside a blue rectangular frame, same structure as above: red bold 'Predicted as' header, column headers 'P' and 'N', vertical red 'Actual' label, row headers 'P' and 'N', thin red grid lines. Cell values: top-left '5' shown in white inside a dark-blue filled circle that overlaps the cell; top-right '25' in black on white; bottom-left '0' in black on a pale-orange fill; bottom-right '70' in black on a light-green fill.

Two binary classification trees inside a red-framed box. Left tree under the red bold heading 'Positive': root node is a dark-red filled circle labeled '30' (white text); two blue arrows branch down-left to a dark-red circle '5' (white text) labeled 'TP' in red beneath, and down-right to a dark-green circle '25' (white text) labeled 'FN' in red beneath. Right tree under the green bold heading 'Negative': root node is a dark-green filled circle labeled '70' (white text); two blue arrows branch down-left to a dark-green circle '70' (white text) labeled 'TN' in red beneath, and down-right to a dark-red circle '0' (white text) labeled 'FP' in red beneath. Two red outlined curved arrows (hollow, pointing downward/outward) sit at the far left and far right edges of the box.

Two simple light-gray line-art fish sketches: one beneath the 'Positive' heading (fish facing left, with eye, gill and fin outlines) and one beneath the 'Negative' heading (fish facing left with a row of small circular scale spots along its body).

typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Calibri/Arial-like). The title 'Precision' is very large (~40 pt equivalent), bold, dark red, centered over the left column. Body text in the gray and yellow bands is bold black at ~16-18 pt; 'Meaning' is bold red at ~20 pt; 'Predicted' is red and underlined; 'POSITIVE' is bold blue. The formula is bold black with a stacked fraction. The worked-example box uses bold blue text. The caption 'All Samples classified as Positive' is red and italic; the bottom takeaway lines are bold italic (first line blue, second line red). Matrix headers 'Predicted as' and 'Actual' are bold red, with 'Actual' rotated 90 degrees. Tree headings 'Positive' (red) and 'Negative' (green) are bold; node numbers are white bold inside filled circles; leaf labels TP/FN/TN/FP are small bold red. No bullet glyphs are used anywhere; content is organized in bordered boxes and callouts.

recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 white slide (approx. 900x487 px reference). Draw a thin red (#C00000) rectangle outline framing the content area from about x=6% to x=94%, y=8% to y=93%.
2. Add the title 'Precision' in bold dark red (#C00000), ~40 pt, centered horizontally over the left two-thirds of the slide at y≈11%-19%.

3. Add a gray (#D9D9D9) rectangle at x=7.5%-68%, y=20.5%-32%. Inside it, place centered bold black text 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)' (~16 pt), a red horizontal line spanning nearly the full inner width just below it, and centered bold black text 'Total Classified as Positive (either Correct and Erroneous)' (~16 pt) below the line.

4. Add a pale-yellow (#FFF9CC) rectangle at x=7.5%-65%, y=37%-47%. Put 'Meaning' in bold red (#C00000) ~20 pt at the left, and beneath it the line '% of what you Predicted as POSITIVE is Actually Positive' in bold black, with 'Predicted' in red and underlined and 'POSITIVE' in bold blue (#0070C0).

5. Add a white rounded rectangle with a thick red (#C00000) outline at x=7%-33%, y=48%-58.5%. Inside, set bold black 'Precision =' followed by a stacked fraction: numerator 'TP', a horizontal fraction bar, denominator 'TP + FP'.
6. Add a light-blue (#DEEAF6) rectangle with a thin blue border at x=35%-55%, y=53.5%-61.5% containing two centered bold blue lines: 'Precision= 5/(5+0)' and '= 100%'.

7. Add two callout tags below the formula: a pale-yellow (#FFF2CC) tag at x=12%-22%, y=63.5%-70% reading 'Positive' / 'Classified as +ve' in black with a yellow pointer tail aimed up at the 'TP' numerator; a pale-orange (#FCE4D6) tag at x=23%-33%, y=63.5%-70% reading 'Negative' / 'Classified as +ve' in black with an orange pointer tail aimed up at the 'FP' denominator.
8. Draw a green (#00B050) horizontal curly brace spanning both tags (x=11%-32%, y=71%-74%) and place the red italic caption 'All Samples classified as Positive' centered beneath it at y≈76%-79%.

9. Add a light-blue (#EAF1FA) rectangle with a thin border at x=6.7%-54.5%, y=81%-92%. Inside, put 'Whatever objects you retrieved as positive, I can trust you' in bold blue italics and '(Irrespective of how many MISSED Positive samples)' in bold red italics.

10. Build the upper-right symbolic confusion matrix: a blue (#2E5C8A) rectangular frame at x=70%-90%, y=10%-30%; red bold 'Predicted as' centered above the grid; a 2x2 grid with thin red grid lines; black column headers 'P' and 'N' on top; black row headers 'P' and 'N' on the left; a vertical red bold 'Actual' label rotated 90 degrees outside the left edge; cell fills: TP light green (#92D050), FN white, FP white, TN light green (#92D050), with black bold cell text.

11. Build the lower-right numeric confusion matrix identically at x=70%-90%, y=31%-52.5%, with cell values 5 (top-left), 25 (top-right), 0 (bottom-left), 70 (bottom-right). Draw the left tree: dark-red (#C00000) circle '30' (white bold text) at approx. x=63%-66%, y=70%-75%; two blue (#1F4E79) arrows down-left to a dark-red circle '5' (x=58%-61%, y=81%-86%) and down-right to a dark-green (#009245) circle '25' (x=67%-70%, y=81%-86%); add small bold red labels 'TP' and 'FN' beneath those circles.
